authority: Explicit user authorizes implementation, technical qualification and Slurm execution for the single V14 B1 specified here. experiment.requests: same fixed first100 and native context order as v12/v13 B1; original occurrences retained
experiment.start: cold W0/H0; not a continuation of any V13 committed state
experiment.model_profile: v12 Llama3-8B-Instruct/CounterFact, all L4-L8, native readout/token/context conventions
experiment.terminal: last fully evaluated common finite candidate
experiment.comparison: Reuse existing V13 RT/RD endpoints only when source/input/W0/H0/runtime/evaluator identities match. Unavailable or mismatched comparator is reported, not an automatic new fit or execution blocker.
experiment.existing_v13: unchanged; no cancellation, replacement, mutation or old-job resume

method_locks.writer: native MEMIT-H mean-key ridge with A=lambda_C*C0+H_entry; same stored-A solve and native dtype/cast/add; no exact writer
method_locks.variables: R_lr=a_lr*u_lr is actual solve RHS, all anchors fixed at entry
method_locks.norm: v12 requested-u penalty beta_r sum_l ||u_lr||, beta_r=.5/a_star; not realized-v penalty
method_locks.candidate: fresh causal actual upper K after candidate lower all-token writes; native rewrite-only key means, all original request columns
method_locks.fit: native subject-only loss forward injects actual writer action v=U*k_actual (FP32 materialized reference); full K/P/upper-key gradients and whole-B coupling
method_locks.optimizer: v12 EfficiencyAdam with summed native request objective gradients, synchronous updates, per-request budget projection/moments, common candidate termination; no permanent early-freeze of independent requests
method_locks.target: local z=h_actual_pre+R conceptually; actual stored R used directly, no inherited tracking addition or divisor
method_locks.history: native rewrite-only final mean Gram, once at every eligible layer; keep KL propagation in builder but no KL history Gram
method_locks.all_layers: remain variables even at zero R; do not remove zero-site gradient/reentry paths

qualification.CPU: reproduce eight reference checks and meaningful implementation tests
qualification.actual: small operator/gradient/commit checks using B1 rows/slices, restored to W0/H0; no separate sequential trial and no additional full-batch optimization
required: accepted payload commit, history once and rollback
qualification.technical_failure: record/rollback and repair same-contract implementation before valid run; no silent scientific substitutions
qualification.science_not_gate: rank/share shape, realized ratio below1, high finite Q or low PS/NS/ACC remain results. B1 ends after report and does not trigger automatic method or budget changes.

measurements.before_after: W0 and B1 same100 requests, all original rewrite/paraphrase/neighborhood prompts (default denominators100/200/1000), no success filtering
primary: mean/canonical/rewrite/KL requested-to-actual norm ratio, directional ratio, cosine, relative error and coverage
planned requested share versus actual direct-action share; zero-owner leakage/cross-talk
R/P desired-new and N desired-true strict TF ACC, token-micro and prompt-macro ACC
NLL for new and true answers, margin, paired lost/gained and W0-success retention
measurements.locality: explicit W0->B1 NS/ACC/margin deterioration and lost previously-correct neighbors; report finite damaging result fully, do not hide by denominator changes
contract: actual RHS equals budgeted R; no inherited addition
masked fit NLL versus deployed actual NLL
Q and weight norm, requested budget, component gradients, shared terminal index
measurements.interpretation: Native ridge may intentionally realize below1. Judge actual task/locality with writer-realized planning, not exactness alone; no lifelong retention conclusion from B1.
